🌸 **Welcome to ASMR Toy Studio!** 🧸

🧪 Create your own slime and squishies! Customize, decorate, save, and show off your creations to other players!
🎧 Explore all kinds of satisfying ASMR toys!
🛍️ Visit the ASMR Shop to discover fun decorations, ingredients, and new items!
⭐ Claim a table, get creative, and relax with friends!

Put on your headphones for the best satisfying ASMR experience! 🎧✨

🛠️ **BETA:** This game is still in development! Expect bugs, improvements, and exciting new updates!
